name: 🌮 Taco Fiesta
what: Seasoned turkey in a skillet, warm tortillas, and everyone builds their own.

core.name: Ground turkey
core.out: ground beef or chicken, same way

core.name: Taco seasoning
core.out: 1 Tbsp chili powder + 1 tsp cumin + salt

core.name: Tortillas (soft or hard)
core.out: chips for nachos, or rice for taco bowls

extras: black beans, taco sauce, lettuce, sour cream, salsa, avocado, limes

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 200°F.
Brown the turkey in a hot pan with a little oil. Leave it alone the first 3 minutes, then break it up.
Stir in the seasoning and about ⅔ cup water. Simmer until saucy, not soupy.
Wrap the tortillas in foil and warm them in the oven. Set out whatever toppings we have.
Everyone builds their own. Save a scoop of meat for tomorrow's lunch.

key: Don't stir the turkey right away. The brown bits are the flavor.
done: No pink left in the meat.
plan_b: No tortillas and no chips? Taco bowls: meat over rice with cheese on top.
